verification.planted_defect_gates: Every invariant is proved by planting the defect and asserting red (E-001: a test that cannot fail is not enforcement). DERIVED without a derivation block; DERIVED naming an unregistered rule; DERIVED at a wrong rule_version; ATTESTED with any one of by/utc/basis/authority blank (parametrised x4); an attestation carried by a non-ATTESTED class; a caller-supplied chain_class and chain_complete disagreeing with the bindings; asserting UNKNOWN as a resolution value; grants_authority flipped to true. All nine fire.
verification.backfill_never_explicit: test_no_derivation_rule_can_emit_explicit walks EVERY subject in the repository and asserts no derived binding is EXPLICIT; test_ledger_holds_no_explicit_backfill asserts the same over the whole written ledger; test_derivation_never_overwrites_an_explicit_binding asserts a weaker class never displaces a stronger one.
verification.audit_uncontaminated: Two independent checks. (1) STRUCTURAL: test_audit_extractor_does_not_read_the_ledger greps scripts/analysis/research_dag_provenance.py for any reference to the provenance modules - the guarantee is in the source, not in prose. (2) OUTPUT: the audit's computed rollup is asserted to contain no ledger token and to keep its own EXPLICIT/INFERRED/UNKNOWN vocabulary rather than adopting DERIVED/ATTESTED. Deliberately NOT a byte-comparison against the committed artifact: that would pin a SNAPSHOT and go red on ordinary corpus drift while saying nothing about contamination - the exact antipattern corrected earlier today in three other floors.
verification.idempotence: provenance_query.py --backfill run twice: first appended 168, second appended 0 and skipped 168 unchanged. Append-only means a second run must be a no-op, not a duplicate append.
verification.tracked_only: test_evidence_resolution_is_tracked_only plants an untracked path and asserts resolves=false with status DANGLING; test_tracked_paths_fails_closed monkeypatches git away and asserts the tracked set is EMPTY - with no git nothing resolves, never everything.
verification.d1_kept_reachable: D1_CONTRACT_CONTENT_HASH fires zero times on this corpus because the six bare-sha256 Contract fields were rebound to ids earlier today under CH-measurement-provenance-boundary. Kept reachable by a synthetic fixture asserting both a matching and a non-matching hash, so it cannot rot into dead code - the same treatment the audit gives its own unexercised rule I4.
verification.schema_code_parity: test_schema_rule_enum_matches_the_code_registry asserts the schema's rule_id enum and DERIVATION_RULES cannot diverge - the silent-divergence class that left Contract/Family out of findings_export._FIELDS for 20 days.

result_summary: MPA v1 shipped: an additive provenance spine binding FINDING / DECISION / PROMOTION / CLOSURE to four typed origin slots (Evidence, Hypothesis, Measurement Contract, Measurement Execution). Splitting the audit's single originating_measurement_basis slot into CONTRACT and EXECUTION makes declared-but-never-executed a first-class queryable state instead of a footnote. Backfill produced 168 records over 212 subjects: chain_class EXPLICIT=70, DERIVED=64, UNKNOWN=34, with 44 subjects carrying nothing to bind. EXACTLY FOUR chains are provenance-complete - F-091, F-092, F-093, F-094 - precisely the four contracts that executed E-MT-00 earlier the same day under CH-measurement-provenance-boundary. Nothing else in the repository's history has all four origin slots resolving, and that is the honest headline.
additive_only_proof_executed: The findings architecture was not modified: docs/current-findings.md is byte-unchanged by this change (the six Contract rebindings belong to the EARLIER change contract today), governance/findings_export.py is untouched here, and no finding's Status, Confidence, Contract, Family, Evidence or verdict was altered. The four subject record systems are opened read-only. The sole write to an existing governance registry is a NEW surface row appended to closure_authority_index.json for this surface itself, plus the CLAUDE.md index row its own floor requires.
authority_unchanged: grants_authority is const false on every record and pinned by test_grants_authority_is_pinned_false. No G001, no promotion, no config, no ACTIVE_VERSION, no ontology node, no retrain. MEASUREMENT_LAYER_STATUS stays OPEN: this records WHETHER a basis exists; only mt00 PASS AND mt01 COMPLETE makes one admissible and E-MT-01 coverage is 0/27. The Phase-4 enforce gate is deliberately NOT built and no check fails on a MISSING record.

reported_not_fixed.promotion_evidence: All 15 PROMOTION subjects resolve to nothing on every slot, and that is the CORRECT output rather than a resolver bug - a promotion line carries no field binding it to evidence. provenance_derivation.FORBIDDEN blocks the evidence rules for PROMOTION and a test asserts none is ever derived, because deriving by date proximity would be the audit's own weakest inference (I3_DATE_COLOCATION, 325 of its 849 INFERRED edges). ATTESTED is the only honest path and needs per-line user authority.
reported_not_fixed.unknown_residue: 34 chains classify UNKNOWN and 44 subjects had nothing to bind. Recorded and reported; not filled.
reported_not_fixed.d3_d4_weakness: 64 DERIVED chains rest on D3/D4, which reconstruct through hypothesis_registry / research_family_registry. The H-* registry begins 2026-07-03 with 18 of its 20 records authored that single day about completed work. Each such binding carries that caveat in derivation.caveat: reproducible is not contemporaneous.
reported_not_fixed.untracked_contracts_RESOLVED_2026_08_27: MC-ASYM-XAUUSD-M15-V1 (F-091) and MC-MRPRIOR-XAUUSD-M15-V1 (F-094) are now git-tracked on explicit user instruction. Rationale accepted and verified: they are the declared measurement bases for two of the repository's only four provenance-complete chains, so leaving them untracked meant 50% of that set resolved on one disk only. The resolver was ALSO fixed in the same turn - it applied the tracked-only instrument to evidence but resolved contracts by filesystem glob, so it could not have warned about this exact gap. New floors: test_contract_resolution_is_tracked_only and test_every_cited_contract_is_tracked.
